Global Sales Strategy & Operations (GSSO) is the team that helps shape Gartner's mission-critical sales priorities and works with sales leaders to drive tactical and analytical insights. As an associate on the GSSO team, you'll be at the forefront of the ongoing transformation of Gartner's sales force, which delivers approximately $4.9B in annual revenue and working to drive sustained double-digit growth. You will partner with business leaders across Gartner to support a global sales force comprised of more than 5,000 associates who sell to every major function, industry and market sector around the world.

About the Role:

The role is a part of the Global Marketing team in GSSO. Within GSSO, the Global Marketing team designs digital and in-person marketing programs to help prospective customers understand how Gartner's insights, advice, and tools can help them achieve the mission critical priorities that drive organizational performance. The team accelerates sales activity by attracting, engaging and converting prospects through the delivery of compelling experiences across the buyer journey.

We are seeking a talented Automation Developer in designing and developing applications and tools to streamline manual processes, specifically within marketing projects. The ideal candidate will have hands-on expertise in Java, VBA, Excel, Google Apps Script, and Python, with a strong understanding of both MS Office and Google Workspace automation. Knowledge of marketing automation concepts and terminology is essential.

What you will do:

Identify and analyze manual, repetitive processes within marketing operations and propose automation solutions.
Design, develop, and maintain custom tools and applications using Java, VBA, Excel, Google Apps Script, and Python.
Automate workflows and integrate data across MS Office and Google Workspace platforms.
Collaborate with marketing teams to understand project requirements and deliver automation solutions tailored to marketing processes.
Implement, test, and document automation solutions, ensuring scalability and reliability.
Stay updated with marketing automation trends and best practices.
Troubleshoot and resolve issues in existing automation tools and scripts.
Provide training and support to end-users on newly developed solutions.

What You Will Need:

1-2 years of hands-on experience in process automation and application development.
Proficiency in Java, VBA (Excel/Access), Python, Google Apps Script, and advanced Excel.
Experience automating workflows in MS Office and Google Workspace environments.
Strong understanding of marketing automation concepts, platforms (e.g., Eloqua and Salesforce + to have), and terminology.
Ability to translate business requirements into technical solutions.
Experience working on marketing automation projects.
Familiarity with APIs and data integration between marketing platforms.
Knowledge of database management and data visualization tools.
Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills.
Strong communication and collaboration skills.
Master's or Bachelor's degree in IT, Computer Science, or related field.

What you will get:

Competitive salary, generous paid time off policy, charity match program, Group Medical Insurance, Parental Leave, Employee Assistance Program (EAP) and more!
Collaborative, team-oriented culture that embraces diversity
Professional development and unlimited growth opportunities

A career with Gartner Consulting offers an unparalleled experience. We are deeply passionate about technology and its applications and committed to attracting the most creative, talented, and self-driven individuals. Our goal is to elevate our respected Consulting function to new heights.

When you join Gartner, you become part of today's market's most innovative business and technology initiatives. We are recognized as technology thought leaders for the 21st century. You will be expected to bridge technology innovations with an organization's strategic needs and commercial objectives, all within a rapidly evolving digital economy. Our Consulting associates benefit from a collaborative work environment, exceptional training, and robust career development opportunities. Gartner Consulting is the ideal place for you if you thrive on solving complex business challenges with technology.

About The Role

Gartner Consulting seeks a Power Platform Engineer to enhance our client-facing applications, data visualization, and analytics capabilities. This role is for a highly motivated individual contributor autonomously designing and implementing low-code solutions based on the Power Platform stack, both for internal use as well as for our clients.

What You'll Do

As a Power Platform Engineer, your responsibilities will include:

Designing and Delivering Analytics: Craft high-quality analytics solutions primarily using the Microsoft Fabric technology stack.
Architecting Solutions: Lead the architecture of Microsoft Power Platform-based solutions, focusing on Power BI.
Data Modeling and Flow Design: Execute data modeling and design data flows using Power BI and/or relevant Azure tools.
Developing Interactive Capabilities: Build advanced interactive features and enterprise-grade solutions leveraging low-code tools like Power BI, Power Apps, Power Automate, AI Builder, and Copilot Studio.
Enhancing Productivity: Support the development of custom dashboards, interactive deliverables, and innovative prototypes to boost the productivity of asset teams and delivery consultants.
Collaborating Globally: Work with a globally distributed team of consultants to build capabilities across diverse industry and technology domains.

What You'll Need

To succeed in this role, you should possess:

Education: A degree in Software Engineering, Data Science, or equivalent field of study.
Experience (IT/Business/Consulting): A minimum of 4 years of experience in a similar role in a Global, highly dynamic environment. A consulting background is a plus.
Microsoft Power Platform Experience: At least 4 years of proven experience with Microsoft Power Platform technologies such as Power Apps (Model-driven and Canvas), Power Automate Cloud Flows, Dataverse, Copilot Studio, and AI builder.
Microsoft Power BI & Fabric expertise with Power Query, DAX, and Data Modelling in Power BI, designing and building Dataverse and SharePoint-based Power Apps.
Visualization Design: Demonstrated ability to creatively design user experiences using Power BI for data visualizations, dashboards, and reports.
Data Expertise: Proven professional experience with data modeling and data engineering.
Azure Proficiency: Azure Databricks and Azure Data Factory are a plus.
Communication Skills: strong written and verbal communication skills, with a desire to share technical knowledge.
Analytical Skills: Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
Organizational Skills: Excellent organizational skills within a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.
Curiosity: A curious mind, open to new experiences and continuous learning.

Who You Are

We are looking for someone who is:

Innovative & Adaptable: An initiative-taker, quick learner, and an innovator who demonstrates a no-limits mindset, constantly seeking new ways to solve challenges.
Quality-Focused: Possesses a passion for quality and meticulous attention to detail.
Consultative: Exhibits strong consultative and problem-solving skills and a strong drive to succeed.
Data-Driven: Detail-oriented, analytical, and passionate about data and uncovering insights.
Technologically Enthusiastic: Passionate about technology, including AI, staying current with the latest trends, and applying new techniques to solve complex business problems.
Collaborative: A high-performing team player with strong intercultural communication and collaboration skills.

What Gartner Consulting Offers You

Gartner Consulting provides:

Consulting Environment: A world-class consulting environment.
Client Portfolio: The opportunity to work with a tier-one client portfolio.
Compensation: A competitive salary and a structured bonus based on individual and corporate performance.
Career Growth: Clear career development structure with ample opportunities for promotion.
Impact: The chance to actively participate in the development and future of Gartner Consulting.
Work Environment: A dynamic, yet relaxed and supportive working environment that fosters personal development.

Who are we

At Gartner, Inc. (NYSE:IT), we guide the leaders who shape the world.

Our mission relies on expert analysis and bold ideas to deliver actionable, objective business and technology insights, helping enterprise leaders and their teams succeed with their mission-critical priorities.

Since our founding in 1979, we've grown to 21,000 associates globally who support 14,000 client enterprises in 90 countries and territories. We do important, interesting and substantive work that matters. That's why we hire associates with the intellectual curiosity, energy and drive to want to make a difference. The bar is unapologetically high. So is the impact you can have here.

What makes Gartner a great place to work

Our vast, virtually untapped market potential offers limitless opportunities opportunities that may not even exist right now for you to grow professionally and flourish personally. How far you go is driven by your passion and performance.

We hire remarkable people who collaborate and win as a team. Together, our singular, unifying goal is to deliver results for our clients.

Our teams are inclusive and composed of individuals from different geographies, cultures, religions, ethnicities, races, genders, sexual orientations, abilities and generations.

We invest in great leaders who bring out the best in you and the company, enabling us to multiply our impact and results. This is why, year after year, we are recognized worldwide as a great place to work.

What do we offer

Gartner offers world-class benefits, highly competitive compensation and disproportionate rewards for top performers.

In our hybrid work environment, we provide the flexibility and support for you to thrive working virtually when it's productive to do so and getting together with colleagues in a vibrant community that is purposeful, engaging and inspiring.

Ready to grow your career with Gartner Join us.

About the Role
Spiro is seeking a highly skilled and strategic Senior Data Analytics professional to lead our data-driven decision-making across customer experience. You will play a pivotal role in shaping how Spiro measures success, optimizes processes, and scales efficiently. Strong experience in at least one programming language (Python, R preferred).
Expertise in BI and visualization tools (Power BI highly preferred; Tableau/Looker/Qlik acceptable).
Proficient in statistical analysis, predictive modeling, A/B testing, and data storytelling.
Comfortable working with large, complex datasets and developing scalable data solutions.

Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills ability to translate data into actionable business insights.

description:
Company Profile
Since year 2003, Oceaneering's India Center has been an integral part of operations for Oceaneering's robust product and service offerings across the globe. This center caters to diverse business needs, from oil and gas field infrastructure, subsea robotics to automated material handling & logistics.
Our multidisciplinary team offers a wide spectrum of solutions, encompassing Subsea Engineering, Robotics, Automation, Control Systems, Software Development, Asset Integrity Management, Inspection, ROV operations, Field Network Management, Graphics Design & Animation, and more.
In addition to these technical functions, Oceaneering India Center plays host to several crucial business functions, including Finance, Supply Chain Management (SCM), Information Technology (IT), Human Resources (HR), and Health, Safety & Environment (HSE).
Our world class infrastructure in India includes modern offices, industry-leading tools and software, equipped labs, and beautiful campuses aligned with the future way of work. Oceaneering in India as well as globally has a great work culture that is flexible, transparent, and collaborative with great team synergy.
At Oceaneering India Center, we take pride in Solving the Unsolvable by leveraging the diverse expertise within our team. Join us in shaping the future of technology and engineering solutions on a global scale.

Position Summary
The S&P (Survey and Positioning) Survey Data Analyst is responsible for data processing and analysis activities required for job preparation, field support, office QC, final reporting QC, final deliverable QC, and project close out activities assigned by Project Management. This position operates company supplied computers with appropriate software programs to support data processing and analysis tasks. This position interfaces closely with the offshore staff, GIS and Project Management teams to support a range of survey efforts and deliverables under Supervision.
Everyday activities may include, but are not limited to, data processing and analysis support for: surface navigation setup and calibration (DGPS, vessel offsets, Gyro, and MRU), subsea navigation setup, calibration and data acquisition (USBL, LBL, and INS), spool and jumper metrology (LBL, Inertial), photogrammetry and subsea pipeline surveys (As-Laid, As-Built, Inspection and Out of Straightness) using multibeam echosounders.
Involvement with and support of the Company's competency, HSE and quality programs is expected.
This position is based in India. This position is eligible for hybrid work. Ability to travel internationally for business is required.

Duties And Responsibilities
ESSENTIAL
Provide data management, QC, and analysis to a wide range of survey disciplines including but not limited to ROV, Construction, LBL, USBL, Acoustic Metrology, Vessel Sensors.
Exceptional English communication skills, both written and verbal
Ability to work independently and as a team member
Attention to detail
Timely and diligent execution of assigned tasks
Available on an as-needed basis for on-call support, including participation in weekend rotations
Comply with company safety rules and training, conduct operations safely and report any unsafe condition or practices immediately to his / her supervisor
Ensure compliance with Oceaneering's Quality management system.
NON-ESSENTIAL
Prepare process documents
Contribute to improving existing Engineering processes
Demonstrates high level of initiative to accomplish individual objectives assigned as well as team goals
Should be open to travel as per business needs
Work towards individual goals aligned with department and organizational objectives
Comply to organizational HR policies and procedures
Understand and adhere to organizational HSE policies and practices

Qualifications
REQUIRED
Bachelor's degree or higher in related field or comparable work experience
A minimum of two years of experience in offshore and / or onshore surveying, preferably in the offshore activities detailed above, or demonstrates the equivalent skill level and knowledge to perform required duties
Must demonstrate practical experience of data management, data analysis, mapping and data standards and associated software
Possess adequate M365 Microsoft skills, specifically Word, Outlook, Excel, Teams, OneNote skills
Have beginning AutoCAD and other required software knowledge
Understand DGPS, geodetics, and surface / subsea survey sensors
DESIRED
ROV data processing ability using NaviEdit and NaviModel, specifically multibeam oriented surveys
